desc: Build a kexec-capable variant of the 5019 object on the Mac. Only change: bootargs gain nr_cpus=1 (keep maxcpus=1 too, so t6040-image-preflight's ticket-205 check still passes). Why: arm64 machine_kexec_prepare refuses with 'Can't kexec: CPUs are stuck in the kernel' when cpus_are_stuck_in_kernel() is true, i.e. num_possible_cpus() > 1 without a cpu_die method. Apple has no PSCI (spin-table), and maxcpus=1 leaves possible=0-13 (verified live on 5019: possible 0-13, online 0), so kexec is refused. nr_cpus=1 makes possible=1, which passes the check; the 13 secondaries stay parked in m1n1 exactly as with maxcpus=1 today. Same Image, DTB (ramoops), initramfs as 5019 (Image hash must match 5019's), new object via t6040-build-masked-object.sh with the edited BOOTARGS (make it a parameter, not a new hardcode). Deliverable: two byte-identical builds, preflight OK, raw-object-verify --strict PASS, hashes in evidence, the cmdline recorded verbatim for 5021.
